description: This file defines the ServiceValidationException class, a custom exception used within the Apache OFBiz framework to handle validation errors related to services. It includes multiple constructors, getter methods for error details, and overrides for message formatting.

classes.name: ServiceValidationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for service validation errors, extending GenericServiceException, with additional fields for messages, missing and extra fields, error mode, and associated service.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns the list of extra fields involved in the validation error.

methods.name: getMissingFields
methods.description: Returns the list of missing fields involved in the validation error.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of message strings, or null if empty.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Returns the ModelService associated with this exception.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the associated service, or null if none.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the detailed message string, combining superclass message and message list.
